name: 💀 RIP BRAINROT
desc:
🤑 Defeat brainrots, escape from the policeman and put in graves to earn Coins, also OFFLINE!
🧠 Defend your graveyard from other players
👣 Sneak into enemy graveyard and steal their Dead Brainrots!

💀 Welcome to R.I.P. BRAINROT!

[How to Play]
• Defeat brainrots that appear through the tunnel
• Add them to your graveyard to generate Money
• Visit other players to see their brainrot graveyard
• Steal rare Dead Brainrot and dominate the leaderboard!
